covr (development version)
text: package_coverage() longer reports 0% coverage packages whose last file R/ empty (#522). New coverage_to_markdown() formats coverage markdown table, optionally compared baseline, GitHub Actions job summaries pull request comments (#519). Functions nested inside lists environments, fns <- list(= function(x) x), functions defined inside local() ggproto methods, can now traced. default; enable package Config/covr/full_traversal: true DESCRIPTION, options(covr.full_traversal = TRUE) (#113). New with_coverage() measures coverage arbitrary code, testthat::test_file(), run environment like package namespace loaded pkgload::load_all(). allows tools devtools::test_coverage_active_file() use testthat’s runner instead recreating (related #543). tally_coverage() gains = "function", one row function, zero_coverage(cov, = "function") lists functions never run. percent_coverage() print() also accept (#245). report() now bundles Bootstrap 3.4.1 instead 3.3.5, known security vulnerabilities (#639). value() now works coverage objects R code; previously errored anything compiled code. structure coverage objects now documented ?coverage, .data.frame() coverage object ?.data.frame.coverage (#564). report() now keeps Files / Source tabs top page scrolling, returning file list restores scroll position (#232). Fix “argument missing, default” errors tracing switch() call fall-cases (= ,) whose subject piped base pipe (x |> switch(...)) (#630). Lines compiled code gcov reports partially executed (e.g. (x) f(); f() never runs) longer dropped coverage. count covered, covered options(covr.gcov_partial = "uncovered") (#604). covr_error conditions (covr_warnings allow_failures) now keep whole failure output $output file $file. message shows last 50 lines bounded warning.length measured characters (measured inconsistently bytes, multibyte output leave message empty), print() shows last n lines, 50 default. number lines can set options(covr.failure_lines) (#570, #642). RStudio addin now prints message starts calculating coverage, feedback report opens (#404). Fix warning, possibly error options(warn = 2), tracing switch() call trailing comma (#483). Trace files now written atomically, failure save read one reported covr_error (covr_warning allow_failures = TRUE) naming file, rather cryptic readRDS() error (#509). package_coverage() now deletes install_path coverage succeeds, test output referenced failure messages can inspected (@hadley, #615). Avoid cyclic namespace dependency running coverage httr dependencies, R6 (#623). package_coverage() gains allow_failures argument (default getOption("covr.allow_failures", FALSE)). TRUE, failing tests, vignettes, examples code produce warning instead error coverage still returned, e.g. covr::report() can viewed long test run failure (#533). Coverage now reported S7 property getters, setters, validators S7 > 0.2.2, stores class callbacks shared class reference (@t-kalinowski, #646). Fix generational garbage-collection bug replacing traced functions place, without permanently retaining bodies environments (#640). Tracing package faster, parse data now keeps text terminal tokens (@erkurtharun, #644). merge_coverage() much faster packages many traces (@erkurtharun, #643). options(covr.record_tests = TRUE), merging coverage now correctly renumbers test indices traces absent first coverage object (#643). Fix compilation TestCompiled test package R 4.6 using public REAL() INTEGER() accessors instead non-API DATAPTR(). Fix rare edge case count_test called .current_test initialized leading crash (@maksymiuks, #631). Fix rare error clean_coverage_tests NA compared condition (@maksymiuks, #631). clean_coverage_tests now uses length(x) == 0 instead .null(x) account NULL values integer(0) time (@maksymiuks, #631).

(@kevinushey, #574) Prevent covr.record_tests option logging duplicate tests line testing code hit repeatedly, loop. (@dgkf, #528) Normalize install_path path creating directory prevent failures running covr subprocess using path Windows \\ path separators. (@maksymiuks, #592)
